entities.summary: Megan Maxwell is the pseudonym of María del Carmen Rodríguez del Álamo Lázaro, a Spanish romantic novelist whose works can be categorized as chick lit. She was born to a Spanish mother and an American father, who split up before she was born. Shortly after her birth, her mother brought her to Spain and raised her there with minimal paternal contact. Since 2009, she has written several novels.
